jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer (€4.000 – €6.500)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Settels Savenije is evolving. Next to customer-driven engineering and research projects, we are increasingly focused on developing own technology and IP within the changing playing field of the semiconductor industry for the next few years and beyond. The ambition is high, the technologies developed will transform the semicon industry.

This requires a different kind of mechanical engineer.

Not someone who primarily specifies the mechanical design of a part or module based on given requirements, but someone who steps into the unknown multidisciplinary world of physics/mechanics/software/electronics and experiments, and reflects back on the requirements by drafting design concepts for parts and modules, and make that step to a final design once all consequences are understood by the multidisciplinary team members, while constantly aligning on demands with respect to lead time, manufacturability, costs and the right quality level.

Settels Savenije is a group of companies where high-end technology is combined with a passion for people. Besides the strategy to develop own IP, we work for our OEM customer base for which we invent, design, industrialize, manufacture, assemble and test high-tech products, modules, tools and equipment — and we train high-tech professionals, for ourselves and for our clients. Our motto: when a problem seems unsolvable, that's when it gets interesting.

**Job description**

From our base in Eindhoven, you take technical ownership of the mechanical design of parts and submodules within advanced high-tech systems for the semiconductor industry. You will join the mechanics group where fundamental understanding is persued to find the right design approach that enables the strategic project goals. You are the technical responsible for your design, making sure the requirements can be met proven by experimental results or calculations, in strong harmony with the software, electronics and physics (optics, cleanliness, …) disciplines. while keeping the design coherent, manufacturable and on schedule. The output of your work consists of a reviewed and released design (CAD models, drawings, bill of materials), calculations (strength, stiffness, dynamics, thermal, tolerances) and often experimental results (acceptance test, testing for concept evaluation, fit test based on 3d printed part mock up).

You are the point of contact for the lead engineer and architect in the project, from concept to industrialization. You work in the Settels Savenije way: we take ownership of program success, work in close cooperation with our clients' stakeholders and contribute as an independent development partner. Mechanics, electronics, software and physics sit under one roof, so multidisciplinary collaboration is part of your daily work — and where you make the difference.

**Your role**

* Act as the technical point of contact for the lead engineer and architect on the mechanical design of your parts and submodules.
* Guard the quality, manufacturability, functionality and lead time of the mechanical design.
* Perform and verify the complex structural calculations needed to underpin design choices.
* Align the mechanical discipline with electrical and software engineers and safeguard the technical coherence of the total system.
* Work within our quality systems and the V-model, including the associated documentation.
* Contribute actively to innovative solutions for complex high-tech challenges, using modern CAD systems (Creo, Siemens NX, SolidWorks or Inventor).

**What you bring**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, complemented by relevant training in engineering.
* 6 to 10 years of relevant work experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in a high-tech environment.
* Extensive experience in designing fine-mechanical constructions, preferably in high-vacuum environments.
* Strong knowledge of construction principles, mechanical design and tolerance analyses, and fluency with Creo or Siemens NX.
* The ability to approach technical issues integrally and connect disciplines — mechanics, electronics and software.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Knowledge of or experience with the manufacturing industry.
* A proactive attitude, analytical ability and an eye for detail.
* Good command of Dutch and English, spoken and written.

**What we offer**

* A salary between €4.000 and €6.500 gross per month, based on experience and a 40-hour workweek.
* 30 vacation days per year.
* A pension scheme with two-thirds of the premium paid by the employer.
* Travel and home-working allowance.
* Challenging projects for leading high-tech customers in the semiconductor industry.
* Short lines, real technical responsibility and room to grow.
* At STTLS, you work close to the technology, close to the team and close to the result. If you like solving difficult technical challenges and seeing your work become part of real high-tech systems, this is a strong opportunity to make an impact.

Interested? Apply now or contact Toon Lamers (Grouplead mechanics) at toon.sttls@recruitee-inbox.com.

jobs.title: Mechanical & CAM Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
**Manufacturing team · On site in Groningen · Full time**

**The role**

Arc makes jewellery-like precision hardware, a unity of art and function, machined from specialised aluminium alloys and titanium grades. That approach has made Arc one of the fastest growing companies in the Netherlands (Deloitte Technology Fast 50, rank 16).

Quality is non-negotiable, in the materials, in the process and in the machines and tools behind them. We are building a greenfield factory in Groningen and bringing production back from China to the EU. We need a hands-on machining lead who connects rapid prototyping today with mass production tomorrow.

You run our on site 5-axis machining cell from day one: cutting tools, fixturing, CAM programming and milling. Your mission is simple: **one prototype a day**.

**What you are accountable for**

* **One prototype a day:** fresh CAD from Product Design turned into a physical part, overnight where possible. Rapid iteration is the heart of product development
* **The machining cell:** tooling, workholding, CAM and machine upkeep under your control, with procedures written down so the work can be repeated
* **The scale-up business case:** real cycle times, tool life, unit cost and overhead, turned into a clear technical and financial case for growing one cell into an automated multi-machine CNC fleet, together with our automation and robotics team
* **Process specifications for mass production:** more than 100 people and even more machines at our production partner overseas make everything Arc sells today. Your specifications decide what they do and how. They learn from you, and you learn from them

**What you will do**

* **Own machining end-to-end,** from CAM to the finished part
* **Co-develop with Product Design** on every CAD iteration, and hand parts over to our surface finishing engineer in a state ready for polishing and coating
* **Build your own workshop:** a multi-ton 5-axis CNC is already there, and you decide what comes next
* **Learn from the best:** outreach to and visits with machine builders such as Hermle, DMG MORI, Kern, Chiron and SW
* **Work with our machine builder** on the equipment that follows

**Practical terms**

* **Location:** on site in Groningen. You live in the Netherlands or are ready to relocate
* **Team:** Manufacturing, working daily with Product Design, Surface Finishing, and Automation and Robotics
* **Contract:** full time

**How we hire**

* **Apply** with your CV and three short questions. It takes about 15 minutes.
* **Screening email:** five written questions about your career, your strengths and your last managers.
* **Practical exercise** at home, about 90 minutes. AI tools are allowed, as long as you understand every part of your answer, can derive it yourself, and stand behind it as your own best work.
* **Career interview** with the hiring manager, 70 minutes. You start by walking us through your exercise, then we go through your career job by job.
* **Culture interview and references** with former managers, only with your consent. Then an offer. A live case study may come before this step.

You hear back from us at every step, usually within two working days.

**What you bring**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience programming and operating professional 3-axis and 5-axis CNC milling centres
* End-to-end shop-floor ownership: specifying and buying cutting tools, designing workholding, writing high quality 5-axis CAM programs, and getting parts done
* A strong command of GD&T, cutting dynamics, and cosmetic, burr-free finishes
* A detailed understanding of how an industrial CNC machine works inside
* A BSc or MSc in Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent, or a proven hands-on track record in machining instead
* A builder mindset: you enjoy hitting daily prototype targets today while thinking rigorously about unit economics and scale tomorrow
* Fluent English

**Useful, but not essential**

* Designing pneumatic or zero-point fixtures for robotic machine tending and lights-out runs
* Building your own machinery, automation and production systems
* Cosmetic machining standards ahead of polishing and surface coating
* Precision consumer hardware, such as watchmaking or luxury manufacturing
* Mass production: OEE, yield optimisation and cost tracking
* Dutch

We hire on trajectory more than on years. If your scope has grown fast and you can show results, apply even if you do not tick every box.

* Proactief en op de hoogte van nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen je vakgebied;
* Communicatief sterk;
* Een teamspeler die graag samenwerkt in multidisciplinaire en multiculturele teams, maar ook goed zelfstandig kan werken;

**Meer over Huisman**

We ontwerpen en produceren in-house en leveren onze turn-key producten aan klanten over de hele wereld. Klanten kiezen voor Huisman vanwege onze ondernemersgeest, vaardigheden, betrouwbaarheid en innovatieve oplossingen. Wil je voorbeelden? **Wat ga je doen?**

Als **Mechanical Engineer** bij **BMO Automation** ben je technisch verantwoordelijk voor het bedenken, uitwerken en vastleggen van 3D-ontwerpen, samenstellingen en opstellingstekeningen voor onze robotcellen. Je werkt aan R&D én aan klantprojecten, vertaalt klanteisen naar maakbare ontwerpen en zorgt voor een soepele overdracht naar productie en service. Voor onze klantprojecten configureer je de robotcellen grotendeels uit bestaande bouwblokken waarbij je regelmatig met klantspecifieke Engineer to Order features de puntjes op de i zet. In de R&D projecten werk je van definitie t/m realisatie samen met de andere engineeringsdisciplines aan nieuwe producten en features.

  

**Jouw belangrijkste taken:**
  
  
**Projectengineering:**

* Configureren van robotcellen uit beschikbare modules in 3D CAD (SolidWorks) en in ERP, afgestemd op klantspecificaties
* Maken van opstellingstekeningen van CNC‑machines met de robotcel
* Bedenken van klant specifieke features welke je af stemt met de klant, productie en service.

**R&D projecten:**

* Bedenken van concepten voor nieuwe producten en features op basis van specificaties, eisen en wensen. Dit doe je samen met de andere disciplines robot, electrical en software engineering

**Over BMO Automation**

BMO Automation is sinds 2008 specialist in CNC‑automatisering en robotica. We ontwikkelen en bouwen slimme robotcellen voor de verspanende industrie, nationaal én internationaal. Innovatie, kwaliteit en teamwork staan centraal – én natuurlijk plezier en trots op wat we samen maken.

Je komt terecht in een enthousiast en gedreven team van drie Mechanical Engineers. Samen met je directe collega’s én de andere engineeringdisciplines werk je aan innovatieve robotoplossingen die wereldwijd worden ingezet.

  

**Wat we jou bieden**

* **Salaris:** Uitstekend en afhankelijk van je ervaring
* **Contract:** jaarcontract met uitzicht op vast
* **Inwerktraject:** uitgebreid, met kennismaking met systemen, processen en collega’s
* **Vrije dagen:** 38 vakantiedagen (incl. ADV) bij fulltime dienstverband

* **Team & cultuur:** enthousiast team met mix van jong talent en ervaren collega’s
* **Ontwikkeling:** volop ruimte voor groei en verdieping
* **Extra’s:** gratis sporten in eigen fitnessruimte, vers fruit, EPIQ‑feesten en teamuitjes.
  

**Wat we van jou verwachten**

* MBO+/HBO werk‑ en denkniveau
* Afgeronde opleiding in Mechanical Engineering/ werktuigbouwkunde
* Ervaring met 3D CAD, bij voorkeur SolidWorks; kennis van MS Office en ERP (bijv. MKG)
* Technisch inzicht, analytisch vermogen en kwaliteitsbewustzijn; je werkt accuraat en gestructureerd
* Modulair denken; je vangt graag varianten in slimme standaardoplossingen
* Sterke beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

Bij BMO heerst een open, informele cultuur waarin samenwerking en innovatie centraal staan. Jouw ideeën worden gewaardeerd en we stimuleren een proactieve houding. Samen werken we aan uitdagende projecten, behalen we successen en bieden we ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele groei.

jobs.description:
For more than half a century, Serco has walked alongside the pioneers of space. Serco has supported over 50 ESA missions where our teams have helped launch satellites, guide spacecraft across the void and turn data into discoveries that reshape our world. With thousands of specialists contributing across the entire space lifecycle from satellite testing to launch services, LEOP to operations and surveillance, we’ve become a trusted force in national and European space strategies. And now, the next chapter could include you.

==============================

We are working on a challenging and exceptionally exciting mission: to bring cultured meat to the market. Scaling up our cell culture bioprocesses plays a pivotal role in realising this goal.

We are currently seeking a highly experienced **Senior Bioprocess Engineer** to join our **Bioprocess Development** team. This is a hands-on technical role that requires extensive professional experience to execute and guide scale-up tasks, drive perfusion and harvesting operations, and maintain technical alignment with external CMOs.

Full-time · Maastricht

**Do you want the same as we do?**

Would you like to play a pivotal role in bringing cultured meat to market, driving a major positive impact on environmental sustainability and animal welfare?

Are you eager to collaborate with a dynamic, international team of scientists and engineers in a fast-paced scale-up environment?

Are you excited to leverage your extensive hands-on bioprocessing expertise to drive bioreactor operations, TFF/ATF perfusion setups, and large-scale harvesting workflows?

**The purpose of your role**

As a Senior Bioprocess Engineer, you will focus on hands-on execution, scale-up, and technical transfer of bioreactor and downstream separation processes for cultivated meat production. In this role, you will bring deep technical expertise to operate pilot and large-scale bioprocess equipment, execute continuous TFF/ATF perfusion strategies, optimise cell recovery systems, and work in direct technical collaboration with external CMOs to enable commercial-scale manufacturing.

**Your key responsibilities**

Perform hands-on operation, monitoring, scale-up, and troubleshooting across bench-scale, pilot-scale, and commercial-scale stainless steel and single-use bioreactor systems.

Hands-on execution of bioprocess scale-up and harvesting strategies utilising Tangential Flow Filtration (TFF) and Alternating Tangential Flow (ATF) perfusion technologies.

Operate and optimize large-scale continuous and batch cell separation technologies.

Drive technical transfer and maintain hands-on technical collaboration with external CMO partners during scale-up campaigns.

Execute upstream processing activities, including seed train expansion, mammalian cell culture development, media optimisation, and feed strategy evaluation.

Conduct detailed process characterization and scale-down modeling to evaluate critical process parameters (CPPs).

Demonstrated strong organisational skills in project planning, meeting deadlines, executing work, and preparing high-level reports, as well as training other BPD team members in scale-up operations.

Maintain high standard technical documentation, SOPs, and process logs.

**Our ideal future team member**

M.Sc. or Ph.D. (preferred) in Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related discipline alongside extensive professional industry experience.

Extensive professional industry experience in hands-on bioprocess scale-up, bioreactor operation, and technical transfer to pilot and commercial scales.

Deep, hands-on expertise with TFF/ATF perfusion systems, large-scale centrifugation and process characterisation.

Demonstrated technical collaboration with external CMOs, CROs, or technology vendors.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Flexibility to work weekend shifts according to project rota requirements.

We really look forward to hearing about you. Please note that the position is open on a rolling basis and we will be in touch with you shortly following the reviewal of your application.
